generalRules: Specials must be requested at time of booking and cannot be applied retroactively.
Special offers are NOT combinable with each other.
Circuit discounts and long-stay offers do not apply to special/discounted group rates.

circuitDiscount.description: Applicable when combining any bush properties for the same visit, minimum 6 nights. Year-round, excludes festive periods. This is the same figure already documented in CLAUDE.md.

longStayOffer.description: NOT previously documented in CLAUDE.md - distinct from Circuit Discount, applies to a stay at ONE bush property (not a multi-property combination). Year-round, excludes festive periods. NOTE: the 2027 version of this offer has DIFFERENT thresholds and percentages - see soroi-unique-deals-2027.json.

pay3Stay4.description: Not previously documented. Applicable to Camp/Lodge bookings only - explicitly NOT valid for Soroi Blue (Diani). Cannot be combined with any other offer.

honeymoonSpecial.description: Ground Package bookings only. Requires a valid marriage certificate. NOTE: the 2027 version of this offer is substantially more generous and detailed (50% off accommodation for one partner, spa discount, Valentine's window) - see soroi-unique-deals-2027.json. Do not assume the 2026 and 2027 versions are the same offer.
includes: A premium bottle of sparkling wine on arrival in their room
subjectToAvailability: Upgrade to a higher room category where possible
A private safari vehicle where possible

repeatGuestOffer.description: Not previously documented. 5% accommodation discount for returning guests. Not combinable with other offers. Must be requested at time of booking with proof of a prior stay.
